name: motif_find_composer
description:
Find a composer. Finds the composing commands that fit a goal in a linguist's words, or lists every composer that serves a Subject. Each result gives its title, when to use it, its Subjects and its intent schema; detailed adds a worked example and the Subject's page. Reads only; nothing is staged.
Command: find-composer. Agent class: Read.
Goal: What the linguist wants done, in a few words; exclusive with .
Subject: A Subject id to list every composer that serves it; exclusive with .
Detail: Either concise or detailed; detailed adds a worked example and the Subject page.

detail.description: concise (default) or detailed, which adds a worked example and the Subject page.
